notes.title: Controller Support and New Languages
notes.notes:
Big Update! We've added controller support and new localizations, including: 
- French
- Italian
- German 
- Spanish
- Japanese
- Korean
- Polish
- Portuguese - Brazil
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese
- Turkish

We have also made the following improvements:
- Improved CG UI

Thank you for playing EmyLiveShow visual novels ❤️

notes.title: New EmyLiveShow Game
notes.notes:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a small mystical town and make acquaintances that will inspire an unusual book! 
There are 4 different romantic interests in the game: the vampire Emy, the cool girl Nia, the cute mystic Uma and the elegant alien Six.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3137500/EmyLiveShow_How_To_Write_A_Bestseller/

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch
notes.notes:
- Resolution related bugs fixed
- UI optimization
- SFX fixes
- Minor typo fixes
- Added tools that may help with a rare missing cursor bug. If you experience this bug, try unplugging additional input devices if they are connected to your device, or contact us in the comments. 

We plan to add controller input in an upcoming patch!
